name: enemy_break
title: Robot destruction

request.text: One futuristic combat robot breaking apart at the very start. Forceful crunchy metal rupture and electrical POP, fast tumbling armor fragments, fizzing servo failures and a descending dying power-core whine. Detailed cinematic game enemy destruction, clearly mechanical. Tight impactful start, debris finishes within two seconds then silence. No voice, music, repeated explosions or ambience.

purpose: Private audition; not yet approved for game integration.
